llm_response.reason: The site falsely claims users have acquired rare BGMI game items and prompts for social network credentials for account verification. It mimics legitimate game branding (Krafton/Tencent) without being official, was very recently registered with privacy masking, offers no legitimate company/contact information, shows no real privacy or security notation, uses phishing pop-ups, and misuses urgency and authentication prompts. These are strong characteristics of a phishing scam targeting game users for account theft or fraud.
